G-grouse-atv-0008.name: 360 m SE of Spectrum Creek
G-grouse-atv-0008.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
G-grouse-atv-0008.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Sugar-Spectrum FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
7 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 8 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Salmon Arm, about 86 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy NE), Hwy 1 (50 St NE), Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy), Three Valley-Mabel FSR.
Park: 50.49518, -118.39741, where the truck road ends (Sugar-Spectrum FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the Sugar-Spectrum FSR stretch, 3.0 km one way. About 60 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-23, Region 8. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-03.
